description: This file defines a Moose role 'Coocook::Helpers' that provides various helper methods for Catalyst controllers, including URI manipulation, capability checks, redirection, and session messaging.

classes.name: Coocook::Helpers
classes.description: A Moose role providing helper methods for Catalyst controllers related to URI handling, capabilities, redirection, and session messaging.

methods.name: current_uri_local_part
methods.description: Returns the URI for the current request with only the app-local part, suitable for passing to uri_for_local_part.

methods.name: uri_for_local_part
methods.description: Constructs a URI by appending a local part to the base URI of the request.

methods.name: uri_for
methods.description: Overrides Catalyst's uri_for method to raise an exception if URI generation fails.

methods.name: uri_for_action_if_permitted
methods.description: Returns the URI for a given action if the current user has the required capabilities; otherwise returns undef.

methods.name: has_capability
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specific capability, optionally using provided input data.

methods.name: require_capability
methods.description: Ensures the user has a specific capability; if not, redirects to login or forbidden page.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Returns the session's message object for adding or retrieving messages.

methods.name: project_uri
methods.description: Constructs a URI for a project-specific action, including project ID and URL name.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the current project object from the stash.

methods.name: redirect_canonical_case
methods.description: Redirects to a URL with a canonical case for a specific path argument if the current case differs.

methods.name: redirect_detach
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect and detaches from the Catalyst request flow.

methods.name: redirect_uri_for_action
methods.description: Builds a URI for an action, adding a redirect parameter to return to the current page.

methods.name: user_registration_enabled
methods.description: Checks if user registration is enabled based on configuration and whether any users exist.
